name: VerilogEval Machine benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating RTL code generation from natural language instructions, focusing on Verilog code. It is used to assess the performance of LLMs in generating hardware description language code efficiently and accurately.
reputation: A specialized hardware-code generation benchmark that is used in research on Verilog/RTL synthesis but is less established than mainstream coding benchmarks.
notes: Benchmark used to demonstrate superiority of a new open-source 7B parameter LLM for RTL code generation.
